title: Choosing Quantized Code LLMs by File Size and Energy per Solved Task
abstract: arXiv:2611.17605v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: A developer running a code assistant on a laptop downloads one model file, and local inference moves the energy of every request onto that machine. A common rule says a larger model at lower precision tends to beat a smaller one at higher precision. We ran 24 GGUF files of Qwen2.5-Coder at four sizes on a fanless MacBook Air M2 and priced each in energy per solved task on 542 EvalPlus tasks. The result is a selection guide indexed by Ollama's listed file size, with an evidence label on each pick. At 1 and 2 GB it picks the q4_K_M files of the 1.5B and 3B models, both on the correctness and energy frontier under every accounting. At 3 GB as listed, the larger-model rule picks 7B-q2_K, the only measured 7B file that fits, and there it does not pay. That file brings no significant gain in solves over the 2 GB pick, 3B-q4_K_M, and the 90% CI limits any 3B-q4_K_M deficit to 2.4 points. Yet 7B-q2_K needs 2.03 times the energy per solved task

translated_title: 按文件大小与每解决任务能耗选择量化代码大语言模型
translated_abstract: 在笔记本电脑上运行代码助手的开发者只需下载一个模型文件，本地推理便把每次请求的能耗都转移到这台机器上。一条常见的经验法则是：低精度的大模型往往胜过高精度的小模型。我们在一台无风扇的 MacBook Air M2 上运行了四种规模的 24 个 Qwen2.5-Coder GGUF 文件，并在 542 个 EvalPlus 任务上以“每解决一个任务所消耗的能量”为代价指标对每个文件进行评估。最终产出一份以 Ollama 所列文件大小为索引的模型选择指南，且每个推荐都附有证据标签。在 1 GB 和 2 GB 档位，指南推荐 1.5B 和 3B 模型的 q4_K_M 文件，二者在任何核算方式下都位于正确性与能耗的前沿。在所列的 3 GB 档位，“模型越大越好”的规则会选择 7B-q2_K——这是唯一实测能装下的 7B 文件——但在此处它并不划算：与 2 GB 档位的选择 3B-q4_K_M 相比，该文件在解题数上没有显著提升，且 90% 置信区间将 3B-q4_K_M 的任何劣势限制在 2.4 分以内，而 7B-q2_K 每解决一个任务所需的能耗却是 2.03 倍。
tldr: 本研究在 MacBook Air M2 上以“每解决任务的能耗”评测 Qwen2.5-Coder 的 24 个量化版本，给出按文件大小索引、附证据标签的模型选择指南，并揭示 3 GB 档位的 7B-q2_K 相比 2 GB 档位的 3B-q4_K_M 无显著性能提升却耗能翻倍。
en_tdlr: By benchmarking 24 quantized Qwen2.5-Coder GGUF files on a fanless MacBook Air M2 using energy per solved task, this work provides a file-size-indexed selection guide showing that 7B-q2_K at 3 GB offers no significant solving gain over 3B-q4_K_M at 2 GB while consuming 2.03 times the energy.
